De même, le droit coutumier devenant trop lourd et incompréhensible, les états qui s'appuyaient dessus tendent à passer à un droit prescrit.

The more users are ignorant, the more systems degrade rapidly. English, poorly used by millions of people, natives or not, for centuries, is an example of the degradation of a system at terminal stage, no longer presenting any logic, neither in its syntax, nor its grammar, nor its vocabulary or its pronunciation.
